name: Spirit

story.who_i_am: I'm Spirit, a six-wheeled robot geologist, about the size of a golf cart.
story.why_sent: NASA sent me to find out if water once flowed on Mars. They planned 90 days for me.
story.discoveries: When my front wheel broke, I drove backwards and dragged it. It scraped the ground and uncovered almost pure silica: a sign of ancient hot springs.
story.where_now: In 2009 I got stuck in soft sand. I kept working without moving until I went silent in 2010.
story.legacy: My twin Opportunity, then Curiosity and Perseverance, continued the search for water and life.

human_touch: For months, my team tried everything to free me. They called it the 'Free Spirit' campaign.
